mnemolith.configuration.title: Mnemolith
mnemolith.configuration.recollectionStor: Multiplier applied to memory-pressure thresholds before a recollection storm can start.
Soft cap for memory pressure accumulated from imprints in loaded chunks.
mnemolith.configuration.imprintNodeWeigh: Relative weight of imprint-bearing nodes when structures are placed.
mnemolith.configuration.stormAttemptChan: Chance, from 0.0 to 1.0, that a pressure check attempts a recollection storm.
mnemolith.configuration.structuresEnable: Whether the chronicle observatory may generate. Applies the next time a world loads.
mnemolith.configuration.structureSpacing: Documented observatory spacing in chunks. The structure set uses 40, with 16 chunks of separation.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinsEna: Whether archival veins generate in the overworld.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinChan: Chance, out of 100, that a chunk attempts an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinMinY: Lowest Y of an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinMaxY: Highest Y of an archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalVeinSize: Length, in blocks, of one archival vein.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalBleed.to: Pressure added per archival stratum block.
mnemolith.configuration.archivalBleedCap: Most stratum blocks that add pressure in one chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketsEnabl: Whether mute pockets generate. Their mute stone blocks writes.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketChance: Chance, out of 100, that a chunk attempts a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketMinY.t: Lowest Y of a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.mutePocketMaxY.t: Highest Y of a mute pocket.
mnemolith.configuration.observatoryEnabl: Whether chronicle observatories generate. Also requires structures enabled.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistObserva: Lowers an archivist's pressure gate near an observatory.
Lowers an echo strider's pressure gate in a chunk that holds a path imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.compositionEnabl: Whether players may compose extracted imprints.
mnemolith.configuration.maxImprintsPerCh: Maximum imprints stored on a single chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.allowRecollectio: Whether recollection storms are allowed to start.
mnemolith.configuration.maxStormsPerDime: Maximum recollection storms active in one dimension at once.
mnemolith.configuration.logPressureChang: Whether pressure changes are written to the server log.
mnemolith.configuration.pressureVignette: Whether rising memory pressure darkens the screen edge.
mnemolith.configuration.stormScreenShake: Whether a recollection storm shakes the camera.
mnemolith.configuration.memoryAudioVolum: Volume scale, from 0.0 to 1.0, for the local chronicle lens chime.
Scale, from 0.0 to 1.0, for chronicle lens shimmer particles.
mnemolith.configuration.lensPollInterval: Ticks between chronicle lens pressure requests.
mnemolith.configuration.writeDebounceTic: Ticks that must pass before another build or redstone imprint can be written in the same chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.writeDeath.toolt: Whether a death writes a death imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeExplosion.t: Whether an explosion writes an explosion imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeFall.toolti: Whether a significant fall writes a fall imprint.
mnemolith.configuration.writeBuild.toolt: Whether placing or breaking a block writes a build or redstone imprint.
Minimum fall distance, in blocks, before a fall imprint is written.
mnemolith.configuration.extractionDurabi: Durability the extraction needle loses on a successful extract.
mnemolith.configuration.failurePressureS: Instability added to the composition reel's chunk when a formula fails.
mnemolith.configuration.saturatedThresho: Pressure at which a chunk becomes saturated.
mnemolith.configuration.overloadedThresh: Pressure at which a chunk becomes overloaded.
mnemolith.configuration.fractureThreshol: Pressure at which a chunk fractures. Fracture is logged and can spawn a moment replicant.
mnemolith.configuration.muteRadiusChunks: Chebyshev radius, in chunks, where a mute stone blocks imprint writes. 0 is the stone's own chunk.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderEnabl: Whether echo striders may spawn from pressure and whether their AI runs.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistEnabled: Whether archivists may spawn from pressure and whether they steal slips.
mnemolith.configuration.momentReplicantE: Whether moment replicants may spawn from fracture, composition failure, or pressure.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderDamag: Attack damage of an echo strider charge.
Attack damage when a moment replicant copies a melee hit.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistStealCo: Ticks an archivist waits after a theft before it can steal again.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderSpawn: Chance, out of 100, that a natural echo strider spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistSpawnWe: Chance, out of 100, that a natural archivist spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.replicantSpawnWe: Chance, out of 100, that a natural moment replicant spawn attempt is kept.
mnemolith.configuration.echoStriderMinPr: Minimum cached pressure before an echo strider can spawn naturally.
mnemolith.configuration.archivistMinPres: Minimum cached pressure before an archivist can spawn naturally.
mnemolith.configuration.replicantMinPres: Minimum cached pressure before a moment replicant can spawn naturally.
item.mnemolith.chronicle_lens.hint: Hold to read memory pressure. Near archival strata the read reaches one chunk farther, and the stone glows. Sneak and use to blind moment replicants.
item.mnemolith.extraction_needle.hint: Use on a block to pull the strongest imprint into a slip. In a stratum chunk, an empty read also checks the neighbor chunks.
mnemolith.message.extract_empty: This chunk has no imprint to extract.
mnemolith.message.compose_fail: The slips refuse to hold together.
item.mnemolith.archivist_bait.hint: Drop it. An archivist will take the bait and freeze. Compose silence and player slips to make one.
item.mnemolith.archival_tablet.hint: Silence and a player, composed, become bait. A vein of this stone bleeds a little pressure and lets the lens read farther.
